name: Agua Bendita
band_note: mean of blouse and sweater entry $150 (women's price pass, 2026-10-13); hand-band (swimwear brand; rule reads Accessible at exactly the $150 cut)
why: Colombian printed and hand-embroidered swimwear (one-pieces about $170–300), cover-ups and resort dresses up to about $500, sold through its own stores, site and Nordstrom.
origin: Founded in Medellín, Colombia in 2003 by Catalina Álvarez; Mariana Hinestroza.

ownership.owner: Agua Bendita (privately held; US site operated by Agua Bendita LLC, Miami; no parent or investor named in any source read)

quote.q: In Colombia, we found artisans with the ability to make handmade embroideries, a learned task from past generations.
quote.who: Mariana Hinestroza and Catalina Álvarez, co-founders

opview: “In Colombia, we found artisans with the ability to make handmade embroideries, a learned task from past generations.” — Mariana Hinestroza and Catalina Álvarez, co-founders, Our Founders, aguabendita.com

facts_read.source: brand site; Modaes 2025-07-30; nordstrom.com search; Vinted catalogue; TRR designer directory; B Lab directory; GOTS database

price_read.sublines: Agua Bendita women's resortwear (tees, shirts, sweater, pants, dresses, jackets); EXCLUDED: swimwear (its core), pareos, girls/boys/kids, men's shirts (tagged 'men'), bags, hats

Seated as proposed, pending ruling.
